scripts.dev: echo "Run app-specific dev scripts after bootstrap"
scripts.dev:provider:local:verify:stub: sh -c 'node ./scripts/local-provider-stub.mjs & pid=$!; trap "kill $pid 2>/dev/null || true" EXIT; sleep 1; pnpm dev:provider:local:verify'
scripts.dev:provider:opensrc:up: docker compose --env-file .env -p snapspace3d -f infra/compose/docker-compose.dev.yml --profile opensrc up -d ai-provider-opensrc
scripts.dev:provider:opensrc:e2e: sh -c 'AI_PROVIDER_MODE=opensrc AI_PROVIDER_BASE_URL=http://ai-provider-opensrc:7002 docker compose --env-file .env -p snapspace3d -f infra/compose/docker-compose.dev.yml --profile opensrc up -d ai-provider-opensrc api worker && pnpm dev:docker:verify && pnpm dev:provider:local:e2e'
scripts.dev:provider:opensrc:proxy:e2e: sh -c 'OPENSRC_ENGINE_MODE=proxy OPENSRC_ENGINE_BASE_URL=http://ai-provider-local:7001 AI_PROVIDER_MODE=opensrc AI_PROVIDER_BASE_URL=http://ai-provider-opensrc:7002 docker compose --env-file .env -p snapspace3d -f infra/compose/docker-compose.dev.yml --profile opensrc up -d ai-provider-local ai-provider-opensrc api worker && pnpm dev:docker:verify && pnpm dev:provider:local:e2e'
scripts.dev:docker:restart: pnpm run dev:docker:down && pnpm run dev:docker:up
scripts.build: echo "Run app-specific build scripts after bootstrap"
scripts.lint: echo "Run app-specific lint scripts after bootstrap"
scripts.ci:lint: pnpm --filter @snapspace/api lint:ci && pnpm --filter @snapspace/web lint:ci && pnpm --filter @snapspace/worker lint:ci
scripts.ci:typecheck: pnpm --filter @snapspace/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @snapspace/web typecheck && pnpm --filter @snapspace/worker typecheck
scripts.ci:build: pnpm --filter @snapspace/api build && pnpm --filter @snapspace/web build && pnpm --filter @snapspace/worker build
scripts.ci:quality: pnpm run ci:lint && pnpm run ci:typecheck && pnpm run ci:test && pnpm run ci:build
